package com.a.events.b.c;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public record CDData(
    String a,
    Integer b,
    Double c,
    Boolean d,
    Object e,
    Object f,
    List<String> g,
    Map<String, Object> h,
    Object i,
    String j,
    Integer k,
    String l,
    String m,
    Object n
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static CDData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new CDData(
            (String) map.get("a"),
            (Integer) map.get("b"),
            (Double) map.get("c"),
            (Boolean) map.get("d"),
            (Object) map.get("e"),
            (Object) map.get("f"),
            (List<String>) map.get("g"),
            (Map<String, Object>) map.get("h"),
            (Object) map.get("i"),
            (String) map.get("j"),
            (Integer) map.get("k"),
            (String) map.get("l"),
            (String) map.get("m"),
            (Object) map.get("n")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("a", a);
        map.put("b", b);
        map.put("c", c);
        map.put("d", d);
        map.put("e", e);
        map.put("f", f);
        map.put("g", g);
        map.put("h", h);
        map.put("i", i);
        map.put("j", j);
        map.put("k", k);
        map.put("l", l);
        map.put("m", m);
        map.put("n", n);
        return map;
    }
}
